label: ft_topk_div
definition: Per test segment s and reference token type v: B=min(count in base hyp, count in ref), F=min(count in fine-tuned hyp, count in ref), lost L=max(0,B-F), gained G=max(0,F-B). ForgetGenUse_X = sum L / sum c_ref over (s,v) with v in X (Saunders & DeNeefe 2024, Eq 1: total lost uses over the reference token occurrences of X; checked against the paper by the author 2026-10-25). _per_base_correct = sum L / sum B (this folder's first reading, kept as a variant). ID = types occurring >= id_min_count times in the fine-tuning set's target side under the same tokeniser; OOD = the rest. _macro = mean over types of X with sum_s B>0 of sum_s L / sum_s B. Copy splits: v also in the source segment (same tokeniser) or not. Saunders & DeNeefe (2024) Sec 2.1, Eq 1; per-segment clipping and the target-side ID set as the paper defines them (author-checked 2026-10-25).
